title: Constrained defined-contribution pension management: A reparameterized neural network approach
abstract: arXiv:2611.06495v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies constrained defined contribution (DC) pension management under a two-factor financial market model. The pension participant is allowed to invest in cash, two nominal bonds, an inflation-linked bond, and a stock index. Moreover, they can also purchase term life insurance to manage pre-retirement death risk. Unlike traditional literature, we consider a pension member restricted to a general non-empty, closed, and convex trading constraint set that includes no short-selling, no borrowing, and portfolio-mix constraints as special cases. Such restrictions reflect common limits on pension-account trading. To solve the problem, we construct a family of unconstrained artificial markets, in which the original trading constraints are satisfied by adjusting the drift terms of the risky assets. Using a duality transformation, we derive the Lagrangian dual problem and propose a reparameterized neural network method to compute lower

translated_title: 受约束的缴费确定型养老金管理：一种重参数化神经网络方法
translated_abstract: 本文研究了双因子金融市场模型下受约束的缴费确定型（DC）养老金管理问题。养老金参与者可以投资于现金、两种名义债券、一种通胀挂钩债券和股票指数，此外还可以购买定期人寿保险以管理退休前的死亡风险。与传统文献不同，我们考虑将养老金成员限制在一个一般的非空、闭且凸的交易约束集内，该约束集将禁止卖空、禁止借贷以及投资组合混合约束作为特例涵盖其中，此类限制反映了养老金账户交易中的常见限制。为求解该问题，我们构造了一族无约束的人工市场，通过调整风险资产的漂移项使原始交易约束得以满足。利用对偶变换，我们导出了拉格朗日对偶问题，并提出了一种重参数化神经网络方法来计算下……
tldr: 本文针对双因子市场下受一般凸交易约束（如禁止卖空、禁止借贷和组合混合约束）并考虑购买定期寿险的缴费确定型养老金管理问题，通过构造人工市场和对偶变换，提出了一种重参数化神经网络求解方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reparameterized neural network method, combined with artificial markets and duality transformation, to solve constrained defined-contribution pension management under a two-factor market model with general convex trading constraints and term life insurance.
